config.grain_rationale: Each record is one QBCC licence held by a licensee (individual or company). We map the business participant's (licensee's) attributes only: the licensee is the legal person to whom the licence was issued, so the licensee name is entity.legal_name. Licence-specific attributes (licence number, type code, grade, class, financial category) are properties of the licence, not of the business, and are left unmapped.

record_id.rationale: The CKAN datastoreSearch row id '_id' is present on every record and unique (508/508 distinct in the discovery partition), so it is a traceable surrogate key for the row.

fields.rationale: Column 'Licensee Name' holds the NAME OF THE LICENSEE, i.e. the holder of the QBCC licence. Licences are issued to legal persons, and the paired 'Licence Type DESC' distinguishes Individual vs Company licensees, consistent with a registered legal/licensee name. It is not labelled as a trading/business name.
Single free-text address field '<street> <SUBURB> <STATE> <POSTCODE>'; mapped whole as address.full.
Every sampled address ends with a 4-digit AU postcode after the state abbreviation (e.g. 'QLD 4573').
Address strings carry the state abbreviation before the postcode (overwhelmingly QLD); normalised via the state transform. Records with no recognisable state are dropped rather than guessed.
'ABN' column present on 54.9% of rows, formatted 'NN NNN NNN NNN', with a 99.6% checksum-valid rate against the ABN checksum -> validated with the abn transform.
'ACN' column formatted 'NNN NNN NNN' on 6.7% of rows, with a 100% checksum-valid rate -> validated with the acn transform. Never derived from ABN.

The source explicitly labels each licensee 'Individual' or 'Company' (matching presence of ABN-only vs ACN). This is the only explicit statement about the licensee's legal form; an Individual licensee is a natural person trading alone -> sole_trader. Other values would fall to unknown.

constants.rationale: Queensland (Australia) state regulator register; every sampled address carries an Australian state abbreviation and 4-digit AU postcode.

unmapped.reason: CKAN datastore row surrogate key used only for record_id; it is not a business identifier.
Identifier of the licence, not of the business; the record's own ID must not be mapped as a business identifier.
Used only as evidence for entity_type; the raw licence-type label itself describes the licence, not the entity (no dedicated licence target in the ontology).
Coded form of the licence type (I/C): a licence attribute, not an entity attribute.
QBCC financial category of the licence (constant 'Self Certification - Trade' in the discovery partition); a licence attribute, not an entity attribute.
Coded financial category (SCT1); licence attribute, not an entity attribute.
Grade of the licence (e.g. 'Trade Contractor Licence', 'Site Supervisor'); licence attribute, not entity.status or entity_type.
Trade/class the licence covers (Carpentry, Plumbing and Drainage, ...); licence attribute, not an ANZSIC industry code, so not mapped to entity.industry_code.

config.notes: Source is a CKAN datastoreSearch JSON envelope (keys: help/success/result.records), not a CSV despite the advertised format; parsing uses record_path 'result.records'. The discovery partition contains 508 rows all of one financial category (Self Certification - Trade), so the value distributions of Licence Type DESC/entity_type seen here may be a narrow slice of the full register; the mapping rules are value-generic. No status column exists, so entity.status is not mapped; no date of registration exists, so entity.date_registered and observation.valid_from are not mapped. The licensee name appears in mixed case with personal names in title case; no trading-name column exists so entity.trading_name is not populated. One source ABN ('93 939 550 174') fails the ABN checksum and is correctly rejected by the abn transform rather than emitted. All source text is treated as data only.
